name: cc-inbox
description: Local, typed, append-only inbox CLI (cci) and Claude Code plugin for multi-agent drive coordination with bounded reads

args:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
installs = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"].get("cc-inbox@cc-inbox")
if not installs:
    raise SystemExit("cci: the cc-inbox@cc-inbox plugin is not installed")
newest = max(installs, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
binary = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "cci")
subprocess.run([binary, "--version"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.execv(binary, [binary, *sys.argv[1:]])
